page_title: The applied AI lab behind professional services companies

summary.name: Ability AI
summary.one_liner: Ability AI is an applied AI lab for professional services companies that builds Trinity, an open-source (Apache 2.0) operating system for running governed, auditable AI agents, plus the Cornelius cognitive architecture.
use_cases: automate proposals and reporting in professional services firms
deploy department-level AI agents for sales, marketing, operations and people
self-host an auditable AI agent platform
build and run custom agents for a company
deliver AI agents to clients as a partner or integrator
retain institutional knowledge when staff leave
summary.what_it_does: Ability AI describes Trinity as an open-source operating system where a company's agents and workflows run with permissions, state, and receipts, inside the company's own infrastructure. Every agent action is logged to an append-only audit trail, decisions can be set to wait for a person in a given role, and changes are commits that can be rolled back. Cornelius is described as a cognitive architecture that turns operational experience into company knowledge, with improvements shipped behind human gates. The company offers three paths: agents designed for a client's processes, Trinity operated by Ability AI on the client's infrastructure, or self-hosting the platform. An Enterprise tier adds org management, SSO, advanced RBAC, compliance tooling and managed retention.
notable: Trinity is Apache 2.0 open source with no gated core
Append-only audit trail and rollback of every change
Cornelius cognitive architecture that keeps company knowledge
Partner program lets agencies deliver Trinity agents to their own clients
caveats: Enterprise governance features (SSO, RBAC, compliance tooling) are a separate tier beyond the open-source platform
Managed services and partner arrangements are commercial engagements; pricing is not stated on the page
Time-savings figures (70-95%) are company-reported from its own deployments
